column6: Both paragraphs convey the same theological concepts regarding the relationship between the Holy Spirit, Jesus, and the Father, emphasizing the Holy Spirit's dependence on the Father and His role as a helper.
column7: The Holy Spirit is from God and is of God. As Jesus said He did nothing except the father show Him (John 5:19), the Holy Spirit too does nothing unless it's directed from the father. Because the Holy Spirit is the helper, He does not work on His own accord, but works in perfect harmony with the father.
column8: The Holy Spirit comes from God and belongs to God. Just as Jesus said He does nothing unless the Father shows Him (John 5:19), so it is with the Holy Spirit: He does nothing apart from the Father’s leading. For the Holy Spirit is the Helper; He does not act on His own initiative but works in perfect harmony with the Father.
